title: Toddler Diane in Snowsuit, Winter Log Cabin - Vintage 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
Diane
Jan. 1945

Looks like she is posing - - but it just so happens she wasnt that time

253
description: A charming mid-1940s home-front snapshot of a young toddler identified on the reverse as Diane. Bundled up in a one-piece winter snowsuit, mittens, boots, and a warm cap, she stands outdoors in front of a rustic log cabin roofed in thick snow and dripping with large icicles. The print features an ornate decorative black printed border. The handwritten note on the back humorously clarifies that although she seems to be deliberately striking a pose, it was merely an accidental candid moment.
